title: State liability prohibited.
bodyText: The State shall not be liable to a participating community development financial institution for payment of the principal, interest, or any late charges on a loan made by a participating community development financial institution to a qualified condominium association under this part.
bodyHtml: [§514D-18]  State liability prohibited.  The State shall not be liable to a participating community development financial institution for payment of the principal, interest, or any late charges on a loan made by a participating community development financial institution to a qualified condominium association under this part. [L 2025, c 296, pt of §19]
